Re-audit complete. Summary:

**PR #620** opened: https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/620

All 10 claimed feature items across PR #591 (Helpdesk), #592 (PM), #593 (HR) verified genuinely present in current `main` — real schema, service logic, routes, migrations, cross-checked against file:line evidence rather than trusting the PRs' own descriptions. Real command output: `tsc --noEmit` clean, full `bun test` 2281 pass/0 fail across 204 files.

Two real, unresolved issues surfaced:
1. New Helpdesk admin-config routes (SLA policies, escalation rules, team routing) have no role gate — any authenticated org member can reconfigure them.
2. `POST /api/hr/loans` trusts a client-supplied `employeeId` with no ownership check; several HR GET routes lack role gates too.

Both were self-flagged in same-author "audit" comments on the original PRs and never fixed — none of the three PRs actually got an independent reviewer's sign-off despite the repo's Rule 7(c)/10 requiring one.

Per the task spec, this PR is report-only and requires a fresh supervisor audit before merge — I have not merged it myself.
